extracted.intended_audience: BBC staff, contributors, partners and members of the public seeking BBC policies and governance guidance
extracted.subtask_description: An index page listing BBC corporate policies, codes and guidance across editorial, operational, legal and ethical areas, with short explanatory blurbs and links to full documents. Serves as a gateway to detailed BBC rules on conduct, broadcasting, partnerships, finance, inclusion, safeguarding and more.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policies and guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Our policies and guidelines are important in ensuring we deliver our mission and public purposes

rubrics_metrics.name: BBC code of conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: We let our staff know what we expect from them - and how our leaders will behave

rubrics_metrics.name: Charities
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to our two corporate charities we also support a broad range of charities through weekly and monthly broadcast appeals

rubrics_metrics.name: Child protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Our policy and code of conduct are to ensure the safeguarding of children and young people working at or visiting the BBC

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: How we govern the ways in which the BBC distributes its services and content of third-party platforms

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity and inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: How our workforce and our output reflects the UK as it is today

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: All our programmes and content must adhere to our guidelines

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental sustainability
rubrics_metrics.description: Environmental and sustainability issues have long been reflected in the programmes and content we make and broadcast and it is important to us that they are also embedded in the way we operate and run the BBC

rubrics_metrics.name: Fair trading and transfer pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: The general principles for transfer pricing between the BBC and for its commercial subsidiaries and third parties

rubrics_metrics.name: Licence fee collection arrangements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Board ensures that arrangements for the collection of the licence fee are efficient, appropriate and proportionate

rubrics_metrics.name: Material changes to the BBC’s public service activities and commercial activities
rubrics_metrics.description: How the BBC Board considers changes to the BBC’s public services and commercial activities

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational separation
rubrics_metrics.description: The arrangements the BBC has put in place to ensure effective operational separation between its public service and commercial activities

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: We work collaboratively and in partnership with other creative organisations

rubrics_metrics.name: Ticketing for BBC public service events
rubrics_metrics.description: Ticketed events the BBC is likely to undertake, the principles determining the selection of events and the approach the BBC will adopt in running events

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of alternative finance in BBC content
rubrics_metrics.description: The principles which must be taken into account when the BBC receives funding from partners or other third parties to supplement the licence fee

rubrics_metrics.name: BBC Values
rubrics_metrics.description: Our values set out what we stand for and inform everything we do.

rubrics_metrics.name: Welsh language scheme
rubrics_metrics.description: Our legal obligations in line with the Welsh Language Standards legislation

rubrics_metrics.name: Other policies and guidelines / Freedom of Information Site
rubrics_metrics.description: Other policies and guidelines including BBC workplaces policies are published on our Freedom of Information Site.
